```typescriptreact
  Filter,
  Play,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  mockConformityAssessments,
  mockConformityMetrics,
  type ConformityAssessment,
} from "@/app/(app)/governance/data/mockConformityAssessment";
import { BarChart, DonutChart, AreaChart } from "@tremor/react";

interface ComplianceDashboardData {
  completionRate: number;
  completedAssessments: number;
  totalAssessments: number;
  friaApprovalRate: number;
  approvedFria: number;
  totalFria: number;
  euSubmissionRate: number;
  submittedEuRegistrations: number;
  totalEuRegistrations: number;
  averageComplianceScore: number;
  complianceStatus: string;
  pendingAssessments: number;
  pendingFria: number;
  pendingEuRegistrations: number;
}

const mockDashboardData: ComplianceDashboardData = {
  completionRate: 78.5,
  completedAssessments: 47,
  totalAssessments: 60,
  friaApprovalRate: 85.2,
  approvedFria: 23,
  totalFria: 27,
  euSubmissionRate: 72.0,
  submittedEuRegistrations: 18,
  totalEuRegistrations: 25,
  averageComplianceScore: 82.3,
  complianceStatus: "Cumplimiento Parcial",
  pendingAssessments: 13,
  pendingFria: 4,
  pendingEuRegistrations: 7,
};

// Datos para gráficos
const COLORS = {
  primary: "#3b82f6",
  green: "#10b981",
  yellow: "#f59e0b",
  red: "#ef4444",
  purple: "#8b5cf6",
  blue: "#3b82f6",
  orange: "#f97316",
};

// Función para preparar datos de gráficos
const getChartData = (data: ComplianceDashboardData | null) => {
  if (!data) {
    return {
      scoreDistribution: [],
      timelineData: [],
      statusDistribution: [],
      complianceOverview: [],
    };
  }

  // Distribución de scores
  const scoreDistribution = [
    { name: "Excelente", value: 12 },
    { name: "Bueno", value: 6 },
    { name: "Regular", value: 4 },
    { name: "Mejora", value: 3 },
  ];

  // Evolución temporal (últimos 6 meses)
  const timelineData = [
    { month: "Ene", Evaluaciones: 8, FRIA: 5, "Registros EU": 3 },
    { month: "Feb", Evaluaciones: 12, FRIA: 8, "Registros EU": 5 },
    { month: "Mar", Evaluaciones: 15, FRIA: 10, "Registros EU": 7 },
    { month: "Abr", Evaluaciones: 18, FRIA: 12, "Registros EU": 9 },
    { month: "May", Evaluaciones: 22, FRIA: 15, "Registros EU": 12 },
    { month: "Jun", Evaluaciones: data.completedAssessments, FRIA: data.approvedFria, "Registros EU": data.submittedEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Distribución de estados
  const statusDistribution = [
    { name: "Completadas", value: data.completedAssessments },
    { name: "Pendientes", value: data.pendingAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA Pendientes", value: data.pendingFria },
    { name: "EU Pendientes", value: data.pendingEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Overview de compliance
  const complianceOverview = [
    { name: "Evaluaciones", Completadas: data.completedAssessments, Total: data.totalAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA", Completadas: data.approvedFria, Total: data.totalFria },
    { name: "Registros EU", Completadas: data.submittedEuRegistrations, Total: data.totalEuRegistrations },
  ];

  return { scoreDistribution, timelineData, statusDistribution, complianceOverview };
};


export default function ComplianceDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [data, setData] = useState<ComplianceDashboardData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Estado para evaluaciones de conformidad
  const [conformityMetrics, setConformityMetrics] = useState(mockConformityMetrics);
  const [assessments, setAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filteredAssessments, setFilteredAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("all");
  const [filterProject, setFilterProject] = useState<string>("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboard();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    filterAssessments();
  }, [filterStatus, filterProject, assessments]);

  const loadDashboard = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setData(mockDashboardData);
      setConformityMetrics(mockConformityMetrics);
      setAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
      setFilteredAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filterAssessments = () => {
    let filtered = [...assessments];

    if (filterStatus !== "all") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) => a.status === filterStatus);
    }

    if (filterProject) {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) =>
        a.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(filterProject.toLowerCase())
      );
    }

    setFilteredAssessments(filtered);
  };

  const formatDecimal = (value: number): string => {
    return value.toFixed(1);
  };

  const formatScore = (score: number | null): string => {
    if (score === null) return "-";
    return (score * 100).toFixed(0) + "%";
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const statusConfig = {
      COMPLETED: { label: "Completada", className: "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-300" },
      IN_PROGRESS: { label: "En Progreso", className: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-300" },
      PENDING: { label: "Pendiente", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900/20 dark:text-gray-300" },
      REJECTED: { label: "Rechazada", className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/20 dark:text-red-300" },
    };
    const config = statusConfig[status as keyof typeof statusConfig] || statusConfig.PENDING;
    return (
      <Badge className={config.className}>
        {config.label}
      </Badge>
    );
  };

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Datos para gráficos
  const chartData = getChartData(data);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Shield className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {t("governance.complianceDashboard.title", "Dashboard de Compliance")}
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
              {t("governance.complianceDashboard.subtitle", "Métricas y KPIs de cumplimiento EU AI Act")}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={loadDashboard} variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("governance.complianceDashboard.refresh", "Actualizar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* KPIs Principales */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {/* % Completitud Compliance */}
          <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
            <CardBody className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex-grow">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                    {t("governance.complianceDashboard.completionRate")}
                  </p>
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                    {formatDecimal(data?.completionRate || 0)}%
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {data?.completedAssessments || 0}/{data?.totalAssessments || 0}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <CheckCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-primary flex-shrink-0" />
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* FRIA Aprobadas */}
          <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">
            <CardBody className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex-grow">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                    {t("governance.complianceDashboard.friaApproved")}
                  </p>
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                    {formatDecimal(data?.friaApprovalRate || 0)}%
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {data?.approvedFria || 0}/{data?.totalFria || 0}

            <CardBody>

                    {t("compliance.conformity.list.filterStatus", "Estado")}

                  >
                    <option value="all">{t("compliance.conformity.list.all", "Todos")}</option>
                    <option value="PENDING">{t("compliance.conformity.list.pending", "Pendiente")}</option>
                    <option value="IN_PROGRESS">{t("compliance.conformity.list.inProgress", "En Progreso")}</option>
                    <option value="COMPLETED">{t("compliance.conformity.list.completed", "Completada")}</option>
                    <option value="REJECTED">{t("compliance.conformity.list.rejected", "Rechazada")}</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">
                    {t("compliance.conformity.list.filterProject", "Proyecto")}
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder={t("compliance.conformity.list.searchProject", "Buscar por proyecto...")}
                    value={filterProject}
                    onChange={(e) => setFilterProject(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-end">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setFilterStatus("all");
                      setFilterProject("");
                    }}
                    className="w-full"
                  >
                    {t("compliance.conformity.list.clearFilters", "Limpiar Filtros")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Tabla de Evaluaciones */}
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b">
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.project", "Proyecto")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.date", "Fecha")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.step2", "Step 2")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.step3", "Step 3")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.overall", "Overall")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.status", "Estado")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredAssessments.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={7} className="text-center p-8 text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("compliance.conformity.list.noResults", "No se encontraron evaluaciones")}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      filteredAssessments.map((assessment) => (
                        <tr key={assessment.id} className="border-b hover:bg-muted/50">
                          <td className="p-2 font-medium">{assessment.projectName}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Date(assessment.assessmentDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.step2QmsScore !== null ? "font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.step2QmsScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.step3DocScore !== null ? "font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.step3DocScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.overallScore !== null ? "font-bold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.overallScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">{getStatusBadge(assessment.status)}</td>
                          <td className="p-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/assessments/${assessment.id}`)}
                                title={t("compliance.conformity.list.viewDetails", "Ver detalle")}
                              >
                                <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </Button>
                              {assessment.status === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/conformity-review?assessmentId=${assessment.id}`)}
                                  title={t("compliance.conformity.list.continue", "Continuar evaluación")}
                                >
                                  <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                                </Button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Shield,
  CheckCircle,
  FileText,
  Database,
  TrendingUp,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  RefreshCw,
  Bell,
  FileCheck,
  Award,
  Eye,
  ArrowRight,
  Filter,
  Play,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  mockConformityAssessments,
  mockConformityMetrics,
  type ConformityAssessment,
} from "@/app/(app)/governance/data/mockConformityAssessment";
import { BarChart, DonutChart, AreaChart } from "@tremor/react";

interface ComplianceDashboardData {
  completionRate: number;
  completedAssessments: number;
  totalAssessments: number;
  friaApprovalRate: number;
  approvedFria: number;
  totalFria: number;
  euSubmissionRate: number;
  submittedEuRegistrations: number;
  totalEuRegistrations: number;
  averageComplianceScore: number;
  complianceStatus: string;
  pendingAssessments: number;
  pendingFria: number;
  pendingEuRegistrations: number;
}

const mockDashboardData: ComplianceDashboardData = {
  completionRate: 78.5,
  completedAssessments: 47,
  totalAssessments: 60,
  friaApprovalRate: 85.2,
  approvedFria: 23,
  totalFria: 27,
  euSubmissionRate: 72.0,
  submittedEuRegistrations: 18,
  totalEuRegistrations: 25,
  averageComplianceScore: 82.3,
  complianceStatus: "Cumplimiento Parcial",
  pendingAssessments: 13,
  pendingFria: 4,
  pendingEuRegistrations: 7,
};

// Datos para gráficos
const COLORS = {
  primary: "#3b82f6",
  green: "#10b981",
  yellow: "#f59e0b",
  red: "#ef4444",
  purple: "#8b5cf6",
  blue: "#3b82f6",
  orange: "#f97316",
};

// Función para preparar datos de gráficos
const getChartData = (data: ComplianceDashboardData | null) => {
  if (!data) {
    return {
      scoreDistribution: [],
      timelineData: [],
      statusDistribution: [],
      complianceOverview: [],
    };
  }

  // Distribución de scores
  const scoreDistribution = [
    { name: "Excelente", value: 12 },
    { name: "Bueno", value: 6 },
    { name: "Regular", value: 4 },
    { name: "Mejora", value: 3 },
  ];

  // Evolución temporal (últimos 6 meses)
  const timelineData = [
    { month: "Ene", Evaluaciones: 8, FRIA: 5, "Registros EU": 3 },
    { month: "Feb", Evaluaciones: 12, FRIA: 8, "Registros EU": 5 },
    { month: "Mar", Evaluaciones: 15, FRIA: 10, "Registros EU": 7 },
    { month: "Abr", Evaluaciones: 18, FRIA: 12, "Registros EU": 9 },
    { month: "May", Evaluaciones: 22, FRIA: 15, "Registros EU": 12 },
    { month: "Jun", Evaluaciones: data.completedAssessments, FRIA: data.approvedFria, "Registros EU": data.submittedEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Distribución de estados
  const statusDistribution = [
    { name: "Completadas", value: data.completedAssessments },
    { name: "Pendientes", value: data.pendingAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA Pendientes", value: data.pendingFria },
    { name: "EU Pendientes", value: data.pendingEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Overview de compliance
  const complianceOverview = [
    { name: "Evaluaciones", Completadas: data.completedAssessments, Total: data.totalAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA", Completadas: data.approvedFria, Total: data.totalFria },
    { name: "Registros EU", Completadas: data.submittedEuRegistrations, Total: data.totalEuRegistrations },
  ];

  return { scoreDistribution, timelineData, statusDistribution, complianceOverview };
};


export default function ComplianceDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [data, setData] = useState<ComplianceDashboardData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Estado para evaluaciones de conformidad
  const [conformityMetrics, setConformityMetrics] = useState(mockConformityMetrics);
  const [assessments, setAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filteredAssessments, setFilteredAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("all");
  const [filterProject, setFilterProject] = useState<string>("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboard();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    filterAssessments();
  }, [filterStatus, filterProject, assessments]);

  const loadDashboard = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setData(mockDashboardData);
      setConformityMetrics(mockConformityMetrics);
      setAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
      setFilteredAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filterAssessments = () => {
    let filtered = [...assessments];

    if (filterStatus !== "all") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) => a.status === filterStatus);
    }

    if (filterProject) {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) =>
        a.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(filterProject.toLowerCase())
      );
    }

    setFilteredAssessments(filtered);
  };

  const formatDecimal = (value: number): string => {
    return value.toFixed(1);
  };

  const formatScore = (score: number | null): string => {
    if (score === null) return "-";
    return (score * 100).toFixed(0) + "%";
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const statusConfig = {
      COMPLETED: { label: "Completada", className: "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-300" },
      IN_PROGRESS: { label: "En Progreso", className: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-300" },
      PENDING: { label: "Pendiente", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900/20 dark:text-gray-300" },
      REJECTED: { label: "Rechazada", className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/20 dark:text-red-300" },
    };
    const config = statusConfig[status as keyof typeof statusConfig] || statusConfig.PENDING;
    return (
      <Badge className={config.className}>
        {config.label}
      </Badge>
    );
  };

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Datos para gráficos
  const chartData = getChartData(data);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Shield className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {t("governance.complianceDashboard.title", "Dashboard de Compliance")}
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
              {t("governance.complianceDashboard.subtitle", "Métricas y KPIs de cumplimiento EU AI Act")}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={loadDashboard} variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("governance.complianceDashboard.refresh", "Actualizar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* KPIs Principales */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {/* % Completitud Compliance */}
          <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
            <CardBody className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex-grow">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                    {t("governance.complianceDashboard.completionRate")}
                  </p>
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                    {formatDecimal(data?.completionRate || 0)}%
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {data?.completedAssessments || 0}/{data?.totalAssessments || 0}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <CheckCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-primary flex-shrink-0" />
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* FRIA Aprobadas */}
          <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">

                <div className="flex-grow">

                  </p>
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                    {formatDecimal(data?.friaApprovalRate || 0)}%
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {data?.approvedFria || 0}/{data?.totalFria || 0}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600 flex-shrink-0" />
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Registros EU */}

                          <td className="p-2 font-medium">{assessment.projectName}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Date(assessment.assessmentDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.step2QmsScore !== null ? "font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.step2QmsScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.step3DocScore !== null ? "font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.step3DocScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.overallScore !== null ? "font-bold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.overallScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">{getStatusBadge(assessment.status)}</td>
                          <td className="p-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/assessments/${assessment.id}`)}
                                title={t("compliance.conformity.list.viewDetails", "Ver detalle")}
                              >
                                <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </Button>
                              {assessment.status === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/conformity-review?assessmentId=${assessment.id}`)}
                                  title={t("compliance.conformity.list.continue", "Continuar evaluación")}
                                >
                                  <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                                </Button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

Revisando la documentación de Tremor para aplicar los estilos correctos. El problema puede ser que Tremor usa Recharts internamente y necesita estilos específicos. Ajustando los estilos:

```css
  padding: 20px;

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .playground-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 250px 1fr 300px;

@media (max-width: 768px) {

/* Custom slider styles */
.slider {
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #e5e7eb 0%, #e5e7eb 100%);
}

.slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  appearance: none;
  height: 20px;
  width: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #1d4ed8);
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 2px solid white;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.slider::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover {
  transform: scale(1.1);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.slider::-moz-range-thumb {
  height: 20px;
  width: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #1d4ed8);
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 2px solid white;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

/* Animaciones para el playground */
@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

.response-item {
  animation: fadeInUp 0.3s ease-out;
}

@keyframes spin-gradient {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.spinner-gradient {
  background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, #3b82f6, #8b5cf6, #06b6d4, #3b82f6);
  animation: spin-gradient 1s linear infinite;
}

/* Efectos hover mejorados */
.hover-lift {
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.hover-lift:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

/* Texto con gradiente */
.gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  animation: gradient-shift 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes gradient-shift {
  0%,
  100% {
    background-position: 0% 50%;
  }
  50% {
    background-position: 100% 50%;
  }
}

/* Animación de pulso lento */
.pulse-slow {
  animation: pulse 3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

/* Scrollbar personalizado para el playground */
.custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}

.custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.3);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.5);
}

/* Utilidades de texto */
.line-clamp-2 {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.line-clamp-3 {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.line-clamp-4 {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Efecto glassmorphism */
.glass-morphism {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

/* Animación flotante */
@keyframes float {
  0%,
  100% {
    transform: translateY(0px);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
}

.float-animation {
  animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* Efectos de glow */
.glow-blue {
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
}
.glow-purple {
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3);
}
.glow-green {
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
}

/* Indicador de typing */
.typing-dots {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.typing-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #6b7280;
  animation: typing 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}

.typing-dot:nth-child(1) {
  animation-delay: -0.32s;
}
.typing-dot:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: -0.16s;
}

@keyframes typing {
  0%,
  80%,
  100% {
    transform: scale(0.8);
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
  40% {
    transform: scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

/* Animación de slide in */
@keyframes slideInRight {
  from {
    transform: translateX(100%);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

/* Toast notifications */
.toast-success {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #059669);
  color: white;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
}

/* Estilos específicos del playground */
.playground-panel {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.playground-message {
  animation: fadeInUp 0.3s ease;
}

.playground-message.user {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
  color: white;
  margin-left: 20%;
  margin-right: 5%;
  border-radius: 18px 18px 4px 18px;
}

.playground-message.assistant {
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  margin-right: 20%;
  margin-left: 5%;
  border-radius: 18px 18px 18px 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.playground-streaming {
  animation: pulse 1.5s infinite;
}

.playground-config-item {
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.playground-config-item:hover {
  background: rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.05);
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

.playground-document-item {
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.playground-document-item:hover {
  border-color: #667eea;
  background: rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.05);
}

.playground-scraping-job {
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.playground-scraping-job:hover {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* Responsive design para el playground */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .playground-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 250px 1fr 300px;
    gap: 15px;
    padding: 15px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .playground-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px;
  }

  .playground-message.user,
  .playground-message.assistant {
    margin-left: 10%;
    margin-right: 10%;
  }
}

/* Estilos para el modo oscuro (si se implementa) */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .playground-panel {
    background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.95);
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  }

  .playground-message.assistant {
    background: #1f2937;
    border-color: #374151;
    color: #f9fafb;
  }
}

@import "bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css";

/* ===== ESTILOS DE TABLAS CON TEMA ===== */

/* Animación de entrada desde abajo */
@keyframes fadeInUp {

    opacity: 0;

  }

    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeInLeft {

    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeInRight {

  }

    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }

/* Efecto de brillo en hover */
.hover-shine {

.hover-shine::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -100%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),

  );
  transition: left 0.5s;

.hover-shine:hover::before {

}
```

Agregué estilos CSS para Tremor en modo oscuro. Los gráficos deberían verse correctamente. Cambios:

1. **Estilos CSS para Tremor**: Agregados en `globals.css` para que los textos y ejes sean visibles en modo oscuro.
2. **Colores forzados**: Los textos de los ejes y leyendas usan colores claros en modo oscuro.
3. **Líneas de grid**: Ajustadas para que sean visibles pero no intrusivas.

Si aún se ven negros, puede ser que Tremor necesite un wrapper con estilos específicos. Verificando si necesitamos envolver los gráficos en un contenedor con estilos adicionales:


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect } from "react";

import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Shield,
  CheckCircle,
  FileText,
  Database,
  TrendingUp,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  RefreshCw,
  Bell,
  FileCheck,
  Award,
  Eye,
  ArrowRight,
  Filter,
  Play,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  mockConformityAssessments,
  mockConformityMetrics,
  type ConformityAssessment,
} from "@/app/(app)/governance/data/mockConformityAssessment";
import { BarChart, DonutChart, AreaChart } from "@tremor/react";

interface ComplianceDashboardData {
  completionRate: number;
  completedAssessments: number;
  totalAssessments: number;
  friaApprovalRate: number;
  approvedFria: number;
  totalFria: number;
  euSubmissionRate: number;
  submittedEuRegistrations: number;
  totalEuRegistrations: number;
  averageComplianceScore: number;
  complianceStatus: string;
  pendingAssessments: number;
  pendingFria: number;
  pendingEuRegistrations: number;
}

const mockDashboardData: ComplianceDashboardData = {
  completionRate: 78.5,
  completedAssessments: 47,
  totalAssessments: 60,
  friaApprovalRate: 85.2,
  approvedFria: 23,
  totalFria: 27,
  euSubmissionRate: 72.0,
  submittedEuRegistrations: 18,
  totalEuRegistrations: 25,
  averageComplianceScore: 82.3,
  complianceStatus: "Cumplimiento Parcial",
  pendingAssessments: 13,
  pendingFria: 4,
  pendingEuRegistrations: 7,
};

// Datos para gráficos
const COLORS = {
  primary: "#3b82f6",
  green: "#10b981",
  yellow: "#f59e0b",
  red: "#ef4444",
  purple: "#8b5cf6",
  blue: "#3b82f6",
  orange: "#f97316",
};

// Función para preparar datos de gráficos
const getChartData = (data: ComplianceDashboardData | null) => {
  if (!data) {
    return {
      scoreDistribution: [],
      timelineData: [],
      statusDistribution: [],
      complianceOverview: [],
    };
  }

  // Distribución de scores
  const scoreDistribution = [
    { name: "Excelente", value: 12 },
    { name: "Bueno", value: 6 },
    { name: "Regular", value: 4 },
    { name: "Mejora", value: 3 },
  ];

  // Evolución temporal (últimos 6 meses)
  const timelineData = [
    { month: "Ene", Evaluaciones: 8, FRIA: 5, "Registros EU": 3 },
    { month: "Feb", Evaluaciones: 12, FRIA: 8, "Registros EU": 5 },
    { month: "Mar", Evaluaciones: 15, FRIA: 10, "Registros EU": 7 },
    { month: "Abr", Evaluaciones: 18, FRIA: 12, "Registros EU": 9 },
    { month: "May", Evaluaciones: 22, FRIA: 15, "Registros EU": 12 },
    { month: "Jun", Evaluaciones: data.completedAssessments, FRIA: data.approvedFria, "Registros EU": data.submittedEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Distribución de estados
  const statusDistribution = [
    { name: "Completadas", value: data.completedAssessments },
    { name: "Pendientes", value: data.pendingAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA Pendientes", value: data.pendingFria },
    { name: "EU Pendientes", value: data.pendingEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Overview de compliance
  const complianceOverview = [
    { name: "Evaluaciones", Completadas: data.completedAssessments, Total: data.totalAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA", Completadas: data.approvedFria, Total: data.totalFria },
    { name: "Registros EU", Completadas: data.submittedEuRegistrations, Total: data.totalEuRegistrations },
  ];

  return { scoreDistribution, timelineData, statusDistribution, complianceOverview };
};


export default function ComplianceDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [data, setData] = useState<ComplianceDashboardData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Estado para evaluaciones de conformidad
  const [conformityMetrics, setConformityMetrics] = useState(mockConformityMetrics);
  const [assessments, setAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filteredAssessments, setFilteredAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("all");
  const [filterProject, setFilterProject] = useState<string>("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboard();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    filterAssessments();
  }, [filterStatus, filterProject, assessments]);

  const loadDashboard = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setData(mockDashboardData);
      setConformityMetrics(mockConformityMetrics);
      setAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
      setFilteredAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filterAssessments = () => {
    let filtered = [...assessments];

    if (filterStatus !== "all") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) => a.status === filterStatus);
    }

    if (filterProject) {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) =>
        a.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(filterProject.toLowerCase())
      );
    }

    setFilteredAssessments(filtered);
  };

  const formatDecimal = (value: number): string => {
    return value.toFixed(1);
  };

  const formatScore = (score: number | null): string => {
    if (score === null) return "-";
    return (score * 100).toFixed(0) + "%";
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const statusConfig = {
      COMPLETED: { label: "Completada", className: "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-300" },
      IN_PROGRESS: { label: "En Progreso", className: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-300" },
      PENDING: { label: "Pendiente", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900/20 dark:text-gray-300" },
      REJECTED: { label: "Rechazada", className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/20 dark:text-red-300" },
    };
    const config = statusConfig[status as keyof typeof statusConfig] || statusConfig.PENDING;
    return (
      <Badge className={config.className}>
        {config.label}
      </Badge>
    );
  };

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Datos para gráficos
  const chartData = getChartData(data);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">

            </p>

          <Button onClick={loadDashboard} variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">

            {t("governance.complianceDashboard.refresh", "Actualizar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* KPIs Principales */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">

          {/* FRIA Aprobadas */}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

        {/* Evaluaciones Pendientes y Alertas */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

        {/* Sección de Evaluaciones de Conformidad (Art. 43 + Anexo VI) */}
        <div className="mt-6 space-y-4">

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">

                  </div>
                )}
              </CardBody>
            </Card>

            {/* Gráfico de Barras - Overview de Compliance */}
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
                  <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />

                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="pt-0">
                {chartData.complianceOverview.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="h-[300px]">
                    <BarChart
                      data={chartData.complianceOverview}
                      index="name"

                      colors={["emerald", "blue"]}

                ) : (

                )}

          </div>

          {/* Listado de Evaluaciones con Filtros */}
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FileCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
                  {t("compliance.conformity.list.title", "Listado de Evaluaciones")}

            <CardBody>
              {/* Filtros */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">

                  <select
                    value={filterStatus}
                    onChange={(e) => setFilterStatus(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md bg-background"
                  >
                    <option value="all">{t("compliance.conformity.list.all", "Todos")}</option>
                    <option value="PENDING">{t("compliance.conformity.list.pending", "Pendiente")}</option>
                    <option value="IN_PROGRESS">{t("compliance.conformity.list.inProgress", "En Progreso")}</option>
                    <option value="COMPLETED">{t("compliance.conformity.list.completed", "Completada")}</option>
                    <option value="REJECTED">{t("compliance.conformity.list.rejected", "Rechazada")}</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">
                    {t("compliance.conformity.list.filterProject", "Proyecto")}
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder={t("compliance.conformity.list.searchProject", "Buscar por proyecto...")}
                    value={filterProject}
                    onChange={(e) => setFilterProject(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-end">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setFilterStatus("all");
                      setFilterProject("");
                    }}
                    className="w-full"
                  >
                    {t("compliance.conformity.list.clearFilters", "Limpiar Filtros")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Tabla de Evaluaciones */}
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b">
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.project", "Proyecto")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.date", "Fecha")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.step2", "Step 2")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.step3", "Step 3")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.overall", "Overall")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.status", "Estado")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredAssessments.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={7} className="text-center p-8 text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("compliance.conformity.list.noResults", "No se encontraron evaluaciones")}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      filteredAssessments.map((assessment) => (
                        <tr key={assessment.id} className="border-b hover:bg-muted/50">
                          <td className="p-2 font-medium">{assessment.projectName}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Date(assessment.assessmentDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.step2QmsScore !== null ? "font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.step2QmsScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.step3DocScore !== null ? "font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.step3DocScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.overallScore !== null ? "font-bold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.overallScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">{getStatusBadge(assessment.status)}</td>
                          <td className="p-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/assessments/${assessment.id}`)}
                                title={t("compliance.conformity.list.viewDetails", "Ver detalle")}
                              >
                                <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </Button>
                              {assessment.status === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/conformity-review?assessmentId=${assessment.id}`)}
                                  title={t("compliance.conformity.list.continue", "Continuar evaluación")}
                                >
                                  <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                                </Button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Shield,
  CheckCircle,
  FileText,
  Database,
  TrendingUp,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  RefreshCw,
  Bell,
  FileCheck,
  Award,
  Eye,
  ArrowRight,
  Filter,
  Play,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  mockConformityAssessments,
  mockConformityMetrics,
  type ConformityAssessment,
} from "@/app/(app)/governance/data/mockConformityAssessment";
import { BarChart, DonutChart, AreaChart } from "@tremor/react";

interface ComplianceDashboardData {
  completionRate: number;
  completedAssessments: number;
  totalAssessments: number;
  friaApprovalRate: number;
  approvedFria: number;
  totalFria: number;
  euSubmissionRate: number;
  submittedEuRegistrations: number;
  totalEuRegistrations: number;
  averageComplianceScore: number;
  complianceStatus: string;
  pendingAssessments: number;
  pendingFria: number;
  pendingEuRegistrations: number;
}

const mockDashboardData: ComplianceDashboardData = {
  completionRate: 78.5,
  completedAssessments: 47,
  totalAssessments: 60,
  friaApprovalRate: 85.2,
  approvedFria: 23,
  totalFria: 27,
  euSubmissionRate: 72.0,
  submittedEuRegistrations: 18,
  totalEuRegistrations: 25,
  averageComplianceScore: 82.3,
  complianceStatus: "Cumplimiento Parcial",
  pendingAssessments: 13,
  pendingFria: 4,
  pendingEuRegistrations: 7,
};

// Datos para gráficos
const COLORS = {
  primary: "#3b82f6",
  green: "#10b981",
  yellow: "#f59e0b",
  red: "#ef4444",
  purple: "#8b5cf6",
  blue: "#3b82f6",
  orange: "#f97316",
};

// Función para preparar datos de gráficos
const getChartData = (data: ComplianceDashboardData | null) => {
  if (!data) {
    return {
      scoreDistribution: [],
      timelineData: [],
      statusDistribution: [],
      complianceOverview: [],
    };
  }

  // Distribución de scores
  const scoreDistribution = [
    { name: "Excelente", value: 12 },
    { name: "Bueno", value: 6 },
    { name: "Regular", value: 4 },
    { name: "Mejora", value: 3 },
  ];

  // Evolución temporal (últimos 6 meses)
  const timelineData = [
    { month: "Ene", Evaluaciones: 8, FRIA: 5, "Registros EU": 3 },
    { month: "Feb", Evaluaciones: 12, FRIA: 8, "Registros EU": 5 },
    { month: "Mar", Evaluaciones: 15, FRIA: 10, "Registros EU": 7 },
    { month: "Abr", Evaluaciones: 18, FRIA: 12, "Registros EU": 9 },
    { month: "May", Evaluaciones: 22, FRIA: 15, "Registros EU": 12 },
    { month: "Jun", Evaluaciones: data.completedAssessments, FRIA: data.approvedFria, "Registros EU": data.submittedEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Distribución de estados
  const statusDistribution = [
    { name: "Completadas", value: data.completedAssessments },
    { name: "Pendientes", value: data.pendingAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA Pendientes", value: data.pendingFria },
    { name: "EU Pendientes", value: data.pendingEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Overview de compliance
  const complianceOverview = [
    { name: "Evaluaciones", Completadas: data.completedAssessments, Total: data.totalAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA", Completadas: data.approvedFria, Total: data.totalFria },
    { name: "Registros EU", Completadas: data.submittedEuRegistrations, Total: data.totalEuRegistrations },
  ];

  return { scoreDistribution, timelineData, statusDistribution, complianceOverview };
};


export default function ComplianceDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [data, setData] = useState<ComplianceDashboardData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Estado para evaluaciones de conformidad
  const [conformityMetrics, setConformityMetrics] = useState(mockConformityMetrics);
  const [assessments, setAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filteredAssessments, setFilteredAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("all");
  const [filterProject, setFilterProject] = useState<string>("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboard();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    filterAssessments();
  }, [filterStatus, filterProject, assessments]);

  const loadDashboard = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setData(mockDashboardData);
      setConformityMetrics(mockConformityMetrics);
      setAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
      setFilteredAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filterAssessments = () => {
    let filtered = [...assessments];

    if (filterStatus !== "all") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) => a.status === filterStatus);
    }

    if (filterProject) {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) =>
        a.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(filterProject.toLowerCase())
      );
    }

    setFilteredAssessments(filtered);
  };

  const formatDecimal = (value: number): string => {
    return value.toFixed(1);
  };

  const formatScore = (score: number | null): string => {
    if (score === null) return "-";
    return (score * 100).toFixed(0) + "%";
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const statusConfig = {
      COMPLETED: { label: "Completada", className: "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-300" },
      IN_PROGRESS: { label: "En Progreso", className: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-300" },
      PENDING: { label: "Pendiente", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900/20 dark:text-gray-300" },
      REJECTED: { label: "Rechazada", className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/20 dark:text-red-300" },
    };
    const config = statusConfig[status as keyof typeof statusConfig] || statusConfig.PENDING;
    return (
      <Badge className={config.className}>
        {config.label}
      </Badge>
    );
  };

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Datos para gráficos
  const chartData = getChartData(data);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Shield className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {t("governance.complianceDashboard.title", "Dashboard de Compliance")}
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
              {t("governance.complianceDashboard.subtitle", "Métricas y KPIs de cumplimiento EU AI Act")}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={loadDashboard} variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("governance.complianceDashboard.refresh", "Actualizar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* KPIs Principales */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {/* % Completitud Compliance */}
          <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
            <CardBody className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex-grow">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                    {t("governance.complianceDashboard.completionRate")}
                  </p>
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                    {formatDecimal(data?.completionRate || 0)}%
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {data?.completedAssessments || 0}/{data?.totalAssessments || 0}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <CheckCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-primary flex-shrink-0" />
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* FRIA Aprobadas */}
          <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">

                </div>
                <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600 flex-shrink-0" />

          {/* Registros EU */}

                  >
                    <option value="all">{t("compliance.conformity.list.all", "Todos")}</option>
                    <option value="PENDING">{t("compliance.conformity.list.pending", "Pendiente")}</option>
                    <option value="IN_PROGRESS">{t("compliance.conformity.list.inProgress", "En Progreso")}</option>
                    <option value="COMPLETED">{t("compliance.conformity.list.completed", "Completada")}</option>
                    <option value="REJECTED">{t("compliance.conformity.list.rejected", "Rechazada")}</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">
                    {t("compliance.conformity.list.filterProject", "Proyecto")}
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder={t("compliance.conformity.list.searchProject", "Buscar por proyecto...")}
                    value={filterProject}
                    onChange={(e) => setFilterProject(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-end">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setFilterStatus("all");
                      setFilterProject("");
                    }}
                    className="w-full"
                  >
                    {t("compliance.conformity.list.clearFilters", "Limpiar Filtros")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Tabla de Evaluaciones */}
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b">
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.project", "Proyecto")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.date", "Fecha")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.step2", "Step 2")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.step3", "Step 3")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.overall", "Overall")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.status", "Estado")}</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-2">{t("compliance.conformity.list.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredAssessments.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={7} className="text-center p-8 text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("compliance.conformity.list.noResults", "No se encontraron evaluaciones")}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      filteredAssessments.map((assessment) => (
                        <tr key={assessment.id} className="border-b hover:bg-muted/50">
                          <td className="p-2 font-medium">{assessment.projectName}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Date(assessment.assessmentDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.step2QmsScore !== null ? "font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.step2QmsScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.step3DocScore !== null ? "font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.step3DocScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">
                            <span className={assessment.overallScore !== null ? "font-bold" : "text-muted-foreground"}>
                              {formatScore(assessment.overallScore)}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center">{getStatusBadge(assessment.status)}</td>
                          <td className="p-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/assessments/${assessment.id}`)}
                                title={t("compliance.conformity.list.viewDetails", "Ver detalle")}
                              >
                                <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </Button>
                              {assessment.status === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/conformity-review?assessmentId=${assessment.id}`)}
                                  title={t("compliance.conformity.list.continue", "Continuar evaluación")}
                                >
                                  <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                                </Button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";

import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";

import {
  Shield,

  FileText,
  Database,
  TrendingUp,

  Clock,
  RefreshCw,
  Bell,
  FileCheck,

  Filter,
  Play,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  mockConformityAssessments,
  mockConformityMetrics,
  type ConformityAssessment,
} from "@/app/(app)/governance/data/mockConformityAssessment";
import { BarChart, DonutChart, AreaChart } from "@tremor/react";

interface ComplianceDashboardData {
  completionRate: number;
  completedAssessments: number;
  totalAssessments: number;
  friaApprovalRate: number;
  approvedFria: number;
  totalFria: number;
  euSubmissionRate: number;
  submittedEuRegistrations: number;
  totalEuRegistrations: number;
  averageComplianceScore: number;
  complianceStatus: string;
  pendingAssessments: number;
  pendingFria: number;
  pendingEuRegistrations: number;
}

const mockDashboardData: ComplianceDashboardData = {
  completionRate: 78.5,
  completedAssessments: 47,
  totalAssessments: 60,
  friaApprovalRate: 85.2,
  approvedFria: 23,
  totalFria: 27,
  euSubmissionRate: 72.0,
  submittedEuRegistrations: 18,
  totalEuRegistrations: 25,
  averageComplianceScore: 82.3,
  complianceStatus: "Cumplimiento Parcial",
  pendingAssessments: 13,
  pendingFria: 4,
  pendingEuRegistrations: 7,
};

// Datos para gráficos
const COLORS = {
  primary: "#3b82f6",
  green: "#10b981",
  yellow: "#f59e0b",
  red: "#ef4444",
  purple: "#8b5cf6",
  blue: "#3b82f6",
  orange: "#f97316",
};

// Función para preparar datos de gráficos
const getChartData = (data: ComplianceDashboardData | null) => {
  if (!data) {
    return {
      scoreDistribution: [],
      timelineData: [],
      statusDistribution: [],
      complianceOverview: [],
    };
  }

  // Distribución de scores
  const scoreDistribution = [
    { name: "Excelente", value: 12 },
    { name: "Bueno", value: 6 },
    { name: "Regular", value: 4 },
    { name: "Mejora", value: 3 },
  ];

  // Evolución temporal (últimos 6 meses)
  const timelineData = [
    { month: "Ene", Evaluaciones: 8, FRIA: 5, "Registros EU": 3 },
    { month: "Feb", Evaluaciones: 12, FRIA: 8, "Registros EU": 5 },
    { month: "Mar", Evaluaciones: 15, FRIA: 10, "Registros EU": 7 },
    { month: "Abr", Evaluaciones: 18, FRIA: 12, "Registros EU": 9 },
    { month: "May", Evaluaciones: 22, FRIA: 15, "Registros EU": 12 },
    { month: "Jun", Evaluaciones: data.completedAssessments, FRIA: data.approvedFria, "Registros EU": data.submittedEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Distribución de estados
  const statusDistribution = [
    { name: "Completadas", value: data.completedAssessments },
    { name: "Pendientes", value: data.pendingAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA Pendientes", value: data.pendingFria },
    { name: "EU Pendientes", value: data.pendingEuRegistrations },
  ];

  // Overview de compliance
  const complianceOverview = [
    { name: "Evaluaciones", Completadas: data.completedAssessments, Total: data.totalAssessments },
    { name: "FRIA", Completadas: data.approvedFria, Total: data.totalFria },
    { name: "Registros EU", Completadas: data.submittedEuRegistrations, Total: data.totalEuRegistrations },
  ];

  return { scoreDistribution, timelineData, statusDistribution, complianceOverview };
};


export default function ComplianceDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [data, setData] = useState<ComplianceDashboardData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Estado para evaluaciones de conformidad
  const [conformityMetrics, setConformityMetrics] = useState(mockConformityMetrics);

  const [filteredAssessments, setFilteredAssessments] = useState<ConformityAssessment[]>(mockConformityAssessments);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("all");
  const [filterProject, setFilterProject] = useState<string>("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboard();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

    filterAssessments();

  const loadDashboard = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setData(mockDashboardData);
      setConformityMetrics(mockConformityMetrics);
      setAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);
      setFilteredAssessments(mockConformityAssessments);

      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);

    let filtered = [...assessments];

      filtered = filtered.filter((a) => a.status === filterStatus);

    if (filterProject) {
      filtered = filtered.filter((a) =>
        a.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(filterProject.toLowerCase())
      );

    setFilteredAssessments(filtered);

      REJECTED: { label: "Rechazada", className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/20 dark:text-red-300" },
    };
    const config = statusConfig[status as keyof typeof statusConfig] || statusConfig.PENDING;
    return (

    );

              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="pt-0" style={{ color: 'inherit' }}>
                {chartData.scoreDistribution.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="h-[300px] w-full">
                    <BarChart
                      data={chartData.scoreDistribution}
                      index="name"
                      categories={["value"]}
                      colors={["emerald", "amber", "orange", "red"]}

                      showLegend={false}
                      className="h-full w-full"

                ) : (
                  <div className="h-[300px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground">
                    No hay datos disponibles
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardBody>
            </Card>

            {/* Gráfico de Evolución Temporal */}
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
                  <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />
                  {t("compliance.conformity.charts.timeline", "Evolución Temporal")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="pt-0" style={{ color: 'inherit' }}>
                {chartData.timelineData.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="h-[300px]">
                    <AreaChart
                      data={chartData.timelineData}

                      yAxisWidth={60}
                      className="h-full"
                      valueFormatter={(value) => value.toString()}

                    />

                ) : (
                  <div className="h-[300px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground">

                  </div>
                )}

          </div>

          {/* Gráficos Adicionales */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {/* Gráfico de Donut - Distribución de Estados */}
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
                  <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />
                  {t("compliance.conformity.charts.statusDistribution", "Distribución de Estados")}

              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="pt-0" style={{ color: 'inherit' }}>
                {chartData.statusDistribution.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="h-[300px]">
                    <DonutChart
                      data={chartData.statusDistribution}

                ) : (
                  <div className="h-[300px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground">

                  </div>
                )}
              </CardBody>
            </Card>

            {/* Gráfico de Barras - Overview de Compliance */}
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
                  <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />
                  {t("compliance.conformity.charts.complianceOverview", "Overview de Compliance")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="pt-0">
                {chartData.complianceOverview.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="h-[300px]">
                    <BarChart
                      data={chartData.complianceOverview}
                      index="name"
                      categories={["Completadas", "Total"]}
                      colors={["emerald", "blue"]}

                ) : (
                  <div className="h-[300px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground">

              </CardBody>
```
